summary: Confirmed $35 daily (engine, Nov 2026 / May 2027), 50A full hookups, 45 sites, showers + laundry (2023), year-round; military 5% now from the operator; added WiFi, ResNexus booking URL. Long-stay character but 25 short-term sites bookable, 24 free on two future weeknights: passes the five tests.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: $35 a night posted (contact-rates page) and quoted on the operator's ResNexus engine for 2026-11-17 and 2027-05-11 - under $50. Presence: working website with phone (417) 543-8342 and an online engine; Google Maps 'The Hitching Post RV Park & Tiny Home Village' 4.6 from 46 reviews, phone +1 417-543-8342, open; RV Life 4.5 from 8 reviews, $$ (avg $28).

LONG-STAY (five tests): the operator leads with long stays - 'Our park is geared for stays over a month', 'most of our guests are long stays', a 'Tiny Home Village'. But (1) no seasonal-only rule; (2) a nightly $35 is posted and bookable online; (3) nothing for sale (tiny-home lots are rented); (4) the engine lists 25 Short-Term RV Sites of the 45, and 24 of 25 were free on Tue 2026-11-17 and Tue 2027-05-11 (1 occupied each night); (5) short stays need no approval (background checks only for 30+ days). Reads as passing; residents are the majority.
Name: Google and the site's footer give 'The Hitching Post RV Park & Tiny Home Village'; the entry's name is the short form.
Phone (417) 543-8342 matches the operator. Pin within ~45 m of Google's place - OK.
